title: options quotes artifact
description: Measured option quotes from a live venue book, with the timestamp of the measurement. Consumed as DATA (by coverage_cli, by dashboards). A placeholder never belongs here: every number is an observation.

read_only.description: Always true. Reading a book is not trading.

deployment.description: Which deployment of the venue this came from (e.g. 'v2 · Derive Chain').

policy_inputs.description: The policy values the selection used, so a consumer never has to re-derive why this strike.

selected.description: The protective put this venue would sell, per policy. Null when nothing qualified — an unquoted venue says so here, not by a missing field.

premium_bps.description: The executable ask, in bps of the notional the put protects.

ladder.description: Every book observed in the scan, not only the selected one — the evidence a human re-judges the selection on.
